summary: Iter-7 backend (full_bleed Page field) and frontend (full-bleed switch, page-color-fill geometry, page-number bottom positioning, Block tab always enabled, LayersList, Frame-from-text) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 32/32 pass including 6 new full_bleed tests + 26 regression. Frontend Playwright verified ALL acceptance criteria EXCEPT one real bug: 'Frame from text' does NOT shrink a text block when content is shorter than the current frame — it grows slightly (140 → 148) instead of shrinking. The grow case works correctly (140 → 654). Root cause is contentEditable.scrollHeight returning the container's current height (not the natural text height) when content underflows.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Frame from text' does NOT shrink the block when content is SHORTER than the current frame. Repro: add text block (default H=140), set short content like 'Hi', click data-testid='fit-to-content-button' → block H becomes 148 (i.e. el.scrollHeight=140 returned by contentEditable since the editable element fills its parent; +8 padding ⇒ 148). Expected: H should reduce to hug the actual text height (~30-40px for one line). The grow case (content > 140) works correctly (140 → 654). Cause: contentEditable's scrollHeight is the larger of (content height, client height) — when content underflows, scrollHeight ≈ clientHeight, defeating the shrink. Fix: temporarily set the element's height to 'auto' (or measure into an off-DOM clone with same width / font / line-height), read scrollHeight, then restore. Pseudo: const prev = el.style.height; el.style.height='auto'; const h = el.scrollHeight; el.style.height=prev; update block.height = h + 8.

rca of the issue: Frame-from-text shrink bug RCA: Editor.jsx (pages/Editor.jsx) frameTextBlockToContent does `const el = document.querySelector(`[data-testid="text-block-content-${id}"]`); const h = el.scrollHeight; updateBlock(id, { height: h + 8 });`. Problem: contentEditable scrollHeight = max(content_height, client_height). When the editable's parent (Rnd wrapper) is currently 140px tall and content is only 1 line (~30px), scrollHeight returns ~140, not ~30. The +8 padding then yields 148, so the block GROWS instead of shrinking. Mitigation: temporarily set el.style.height='auto' (or measure a clone with the same computed width / font / line-height) to get the natural height, then restore. Reproduction: new book → add Text block → in the contentEditable type one short line → click 'Frame from text' button (data-testid=fit-to-content-button) → block H shows 148px in BlockProperties (W: 360px, H: 148px); expected H should be ~30-50px so the frame hugs the single line.
